recent_deploys.message: fix: collector otelcol.signal scope attribute conflict in logs pipeline (#3321)

ground_truth_root_cause: Commit 05fab63b804f edited kubernetes/currency-service/configmap.yaml to fix an unrelated OTel collector signal scope conflict, but inadvertently removed the custom key http.server.request_timeout_ms (previously set to 15000 ms) from the ConfigMap. As a result, currency-service fell back to the hardcoded default of 5000 ms at pod restart (14:51:03Z). The upstream exchange-rate-svc has a normal p99 latency of ~6800-7300 ms, which exceeds this default timeout, causing 100% of upstream calls to time out with 504 GatewayTimeout responses.
ground_truth_remediation: Edit the currency-service ConfigMap (kubernetes/currency-service/configmap.yaml) to restore the missing key: set http.server.request_timeout_ms to 15000. Apply the ConfigMap change with `kubectl apply -f kubernetes/currency-service/configmap.yaml` and perform a rolling restart of the currency-service pods with `kubectl rollout restart deployment/currency-service`. Verify in logs that the config loads with timeout_ms=15000 and that 504 errors cease. Open a follow-up ticket to add ConfigMap schema validation in CI to prevent key omissions during future edits.
